quizName: Hardest Questions in New york Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: If you cannot avoid a slippery road, what should you do?

options.text: Lean into the slippery section to keep your balance.
Keep your speed to improve traction.
Do not worry about the road conditions.
Keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as needed.
questions.explanation: The best choice is to avoid slippery roads entirely. If you cannot avoid a slippery area, keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as possible.

questions.question: What is an advantage of keeping space between your motorcycle and other vehicles?

options.text: You can pass danger more quickly.
You have a narrow view of the road so you can stay focused.
You have more time to react to what other drivers do.
You can more easily follow the path of the next vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have more time to react to what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: Keeping space between your motorcycle and other vehicles gives you a clearer view of hazards ahead, more time to react to them, and more room to move around them.

questions.question: What does a plastic, shatter-resistant face shield do?

options.text: It is not needed if you have a windshield.
It only protects your eyes.
It helps protect your whole face.
It does not protect your face as well as goggles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It helps protect your whole face.
questions.explanation: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects your whole face in a crash. Goggles only protect your eyes. A windshield is not a substitute for a face shield or goggles.

questions.question: Which surface does NOT provide poor traction?

options.text: Wet pavement
Dry pavement
Lane markings
Snow

questions.correctAnswerText: Dry pavement
questions.explanation: Many surfaces provide poor traction. Wet pavement, loose gravel or sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings are more hazardous for motorcyclists than dry pavement.

questions.question: What happens when you take a turn too fast?

options.text: It is acceptable as long as you stay under the speed limit.
It is safer on a motorcycle than in a car.
It is acceptable as long as no vehicles are near you.
You may end up in another lane or leave the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may end up in another lane or leave the road.
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast is dangerous. If you cannot hold the turn, you may end up in another lane or even off the road. Always use caution when turning.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?

options.text: At night.
During the day.
At dusk.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Wear reflective and bright clothing anytime you ride. Crashes happen in daylight and at night, so it is best to wear visible clothing at all times.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?

options.text: Never.
Only during the day.
Only at night.
Day and night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Day and night.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Wearing bright colors and reflective materials improves your visibility at all times.

questions.question: How should you handle tailgaters?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Use your horn and make obscene gestures.
Speed up to put distance between you and them.
Come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If possible, change lanes and let a tailgater pass. Speeding up may cause them to tailgate at a higher speed, which increases danger.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on another road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you wear to help other drivers see you?

options.text: Dark-colored clothes.
Bright-colored clothes.
Lights.
A black jacket.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright-colored clothes.
questions.explanation: Wear bright-colored clothing to be seen by other drivers. Choose clothes that make you visible during the day and at night.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks does the body generally eliminate per hour?

options.text: One
Two
Three
Four

questions.correctAnswerText: One
questions.explanation: The body eliminates about one drink per hour on average. Blood alcohol content (BAC) varies from person to person. It is safest to not drive any vehicle after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: What color are work area signs?

options.text: Orange with black letters or symbols.
White with red letters or symbols.
Blue with white letters or symbols.
Green with white letters or symbols.

questions.correctAnswerText: Orange with black letters or symbols.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black letters and symbols. Slow down in work areas. Follow all instructions from signs, signals, and flaggers.

questions.question: What should you do when a traffic light turns solid yellow?

options.text: Prepare to stop.
Accelerate.
Put the vehicle into reverse and back up.
Do whatever the car ahead of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light means the signal will turn red soon. Slow down and prepare to stop. If you can stop safely before entering the intersection, do so.

questions.question: When you see all of these at once, whose directions must you follow?

options.text: A steady red light.
A police officer.
A stop sign.
A steady red arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: A police officer.
questions.explanation: Always follow a police officer's directions. They override all traffic signs and signals.

questions.question: What should you do if your motorcycle starts to wobble?

options.text: Gradually brake.
Accelerate.
Grip the handlebars firmly and close the throttle gradually.
Downshift.

questions.correctAnswerText: Grip the handlebars firmly and close the throttle gradually.
questions.explanation: Do not accelerate during a wobble—it makes the bike less stable. Instead, grip the handlebars firmly, slow down gradually by closing the throttle, lean forward, and pull off the road. Do not use the brakes, as this can make the wobble worse.

questions.question: What is a major effect of alcohol on the body?

options.text: Heightened riding abilities.
The slowing down of bodily functions.
Increasing nervousness.
Increasing alertness.

questions.correctAnswerText: The slowing down of bodily functions.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows down both physical and mental functions in the body.

questions.question: What should you do at a broken four-way traffic signal?

options.text: Treat the signal like a stop sign.
Look both ways and proceed without stopping.
Look both ways and stop only if another vehicle is close.
Proceed through the intersection because the other signal may be working.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the signal like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a broken four-way signal as a stop sign. If a police officer is directing traffic, follow their directions.

questions.question: A person drank 8 drinks 4 hours ago. The body eliminates 1 drink per hour. How many drinks remain in their system?

options.text: Two
Three
Four
Five

questions.correctAnswerText: Four
questions.explanation: To estimate remaining drinks, subtract the number of hours from the total drinks consumed. Eight drinks minus 4 hours equals about 4 drinks remaining.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per alcoholic drink before riding, what is true?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your skills will not be affected.
Side effects may still remain.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side effects may still remain.
questions.explanation: Even if you wait one hour per drink, alcohol can still build up in your system. Side effects can remain and affect your riding ability.

questions.question: What is true about a properly-fitted motorcycle?

options.text: The rider can touch the ground with their feet while seated.
The seat is even with the rider's waist.
The seat is 10 inches above the rider's waist.
The seat is 10 inches below the rider's waist.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider can touch the ground with their feet while seated.
questions.explanation: A properly-fitted motorcycle lets you touch the ground with your feet while seated. Keep your feet firmly on the footrests when riding.
